name: Roland XV-5080
description: Roland XV-5080 synthesizer module: the system blocks, the temporary performance (common, effects, MIDI, and the Part block of each of its 32 parts), and Part 1's temporary patch (with its multi-partial split keys) and rhythm set, from the MIDI Implementation chapter of the owner's manual.

sources.title: XV-5080 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, May 20, 2000)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from XV-5080_OM.pdf (sha256 62cca1d66205416ce16450822c9359e1b2a9fd455390f6b61c05917d613403ce). Model ID 00 10, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Performance parts are filed as "Part n" (id part<n>.*), Part 1's patch as "Part 1 · Patch · …" (part1.patch.*) and its rhythm set as "Part 1 · Rhythm Set · …" (part1.rhythm.*); the performance's own blocks as "Performance · …" and its MIDI blocks by channel.

LFO1 Wave Form and LFO2 Wave Form (0-10) print their labels as "SIN, TRI, SAW-UP, SAW-DW, SQR, RND, BEND-UP, BEND-DW, TRP, S&H" with "CHS" alone on the next line and no comma before it (the XV-5080's p297; every XV manual sets it so): ten labels for eleven values, so both stay numbers with the manual's line as their description rather than labels that would be off by one.
Rows the manual tags for other models (`<XV-5080>`, `<XV-3080/5080>`, the XV-2020's `<*>`) keep the tag in their name and choice labels, where a reader sees it, and lose it in their ids.

The manual ends each offset-table entry with a reference mark (`Rhythm Tone (Key # 21) *1-3-2-5`), which the reader keeps in the name and which stops it filling in the ":" run after a marked entry; the map then addresses only the entries the manual prints. Left out for that reason, with their addresses: System Part (a scale tune per part), parts 3-31: the map addresses only 1-2, 32 of 1-32; n is at 00 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 00 00 12 00 and 31 at 00 00 2E 00; Performance MIDI channels 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 12 00 and 15 at 10 00 1E 00; Part 1 Patch Split Keys 23-107: the map addresses only 21-22, 108 of 21-108; n is at 11 00 30 00 + (n-21) x 00 00 00 20, so 23 is at 11 00 30 40 and 107 at 11 00 45 40; Part 1 Rhythm Set keys 35-81: the map addresses only 21-22, 108 of 21-108; n is at 11 10 10 00 + (n-21) x 00 00 02 00, so 35 is at 11 10 2C 00 and 81 at 11 11 08 00.

Identity: the XV-5080's manual (p289) prints family code 10 01 and family number 00 00, the XV-3080's (p180) the same, and the XV-88's byte table (p278) labels them "Device family code (XV-3080/5080/88)" and "Device family number code (XV-3080/88)" — which reads as though the XV-5080's number differed, though its own manual prints 00 00. As printed, the three answer alike (the XV-88 differs only in its revision bytes), and the XV-5050 (10 01 / 02 02) and XV-2020 (10 01 / 00 03) are told apart. Choosing this profile for an XV-3080 or XV-88, or theirs for an XV-5080, is not flagged as a mismatch.

Presets list Patches (Bank Select MSB 87: User 00, PR-A to PR-G 64-70) and Rhythm Sets (MSB 86: User 00, PR-A to PR-G 64-70), p21-22, recalled on the profile's channel. Not listed: Performances (MSB 85: User 00, PR-A/PR-B 64/65, selected on the Performance Control Channel), PR-H's General MIDI 2 sounds (MSB 121/120), the memory card groups CD-A to CD-H (LSB 32-39, present only with a card), and the SR-JV80 and SRX expansion boards (MSB 88-93).

The address map marks "Performance MIDI (Channel 16)" with *1-2-6, the reference to the Performance Part table, and "Performance Part (Part 1)" with nothing (p291); the mark belongs on Part 1. Every other XV manual prints it there.

p303, <Example 4> ("Getting data (RQ1) at once") lists Part 1's temporary patch at 11 20 00 00 and rhythm set at 11 30 00 00, and stops at Part 16 (14 60 00 00, 14 70 00 00); the address map (p290) puts Part 1 at 11 00 00 00 with its rhythm set at 11 10 00 00, and the XV-5080 has 32 parts. It also labels the rhythm set's first and last tones, keys 21 and 108, "Rhythm Tone 1" and "Rhythm Tone 4". It is an RQ1 and is not checked; the address map is what is laid out.
Chorus Type (0-2) and Reverb Type (0-4) print no labels in the address map; the example (p303) gives DELAY as 02.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): part1.patch, part1.patch.mfx, part1.patch.chorus, part1.patch.reverb, part1.patch.tmt, part1.patch.tone1, part1.patch.tone2, part1.patch.tone3, part1.patch.tone4, part1.patch.splitKey21, part1.patch.splitKey22, part1.patch.splitKey108, part1.rhythm, part1.rhythm.mfx, part1.rhythm.chorus, part1.rhythm.reverb.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the instrument receives and transmits as Control Change (received p282-286, transmitted p288-289) is not mapped yet
coverage.parts: the Temporary Performance's Part block for every part the map addresses (of 1-32); the temporary patch and rhythm set of Part 1 only. Parts 2-32's are not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Performance Mode Part n) is at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) x 00 20 00 00 (… 18 60 00 00 for Part 32), its patch at +00 00 00 and its rhythm set at +10 00 00, the same blocks as Part 1's
coverage.patchMode: not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Patch Mode), the patch or rhythm set played in Patch mode, at 1F 00 00 00 (patch) and 1F 10 00 00 (rhythm set): the same blocks as Part 1's at another base
coverage.toneTypes: Part 1 plays a patch or a rhythm set; both are laid out (patch at 11 00 00 00, rhythm set at 11 10 00 00) and neither is read at startup, since a request the instrument cannot answer gets no reply and the engine's startup read stops at the first request that is not answered
coverage.rhythmKeys: rhythm tones for keys 35-81 (the General MIDI percussion keys) that the map addresses; Rhythm Tone (Key # k) is at the rhythm set's base + 00 10 00 + (k-21) x 00 02 00, so for Part 1 keys 21-34 are at 11 10 10 00-11 10 2A 00 and keys 82-108 at 11 11 0A 00-11 11 3E 00; all eighty-eight would be over twelve thousand parameters on their own
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.notModelled: User Performances (20 00 00 00), User Patches (30 00 00 00) and User Rhythm Sets (40 00 00 00): memories, not the edit buffer
coverage.notAddressedByTheMap: System Part (a scale tune per part), parts 3-31: the map addresses only 1-2, 32 of 1-32; n is at 00 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 00 00 12 00 and 31 at 00 00 2E 00; Performance MIDI channels 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 12 00 and 15 at 10 00 1E 00; Part 1 Patch Split Keys 23-107: the map addresses only 21-22, 108 of 21-108; n is at 11 00 30 00 + (n-21) x 00 00 00 20, so 23 is at 11 00 30 40 and 107 at 11 00 45 40; Part 1 Rhythm Set keys 35-81: the map addresses only 21-22, 108 of 21-108; n is at 11 10 10 00 + (n-21) x 00 00 02 00, so 35 is at 11 10 2C 00 and 81 at 11 11 08 00
coverage.splitKeys: every key's Patch Split Key block (21-108) that the map addresses, for Part 1's patch; they apply to a multi-partial patch (Patch Common Tone Type MULTI-PARTIAL) and are read with the patch, on request
